faqs.question: Is Vismuse free to try?
faqs.answer: Yes. Vismuse offers a limited free trial. If you create something you want to keep, you can unlock that eligible result with a one-time purchase, or choose a monthly or annual plan for ongoing use.

faqs.question: Will my image downloads include a watermark?
faqs.answer: Free image downloads include a Vismuse watermark. An active subscription unlocks watermark-free HD downloads for all your images, while a one-time purchase unlocks the current image in HD without a watermark.

faqs.question: Can I use my creations commercially?
faqs.answer: Commercial use is included with eligible paid plans and purchases, subject to our Terms. You are responsible for having the rights to your inputs and reviewing generated content before publishing or distributing it.

faqs.question: What image and video formats can I export?
faqs.answer: Generated images can be exported as PNG or JPEG, while generated videos are downloaded as MP4. Available resolution options depend on the selected workflow and plan.

faqs.question: How do credits and one-time unlocks work?
faqs.answer: Vismuse shows the credit cost before you create. Monthly and annual plans include recurring credits, while eligible one-time purchases let you unlock an individual result without subscribing.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can cancel anytime. Your paid access will remain active until the end of the current billing period, and you will not be charged for the next one.
